allow: PowerShell(try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://teeth886.github.io" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Status: $\($response.StatusCode\)"; Write-Host "--- First 500 chars ---"; $response.Content.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(500, $response.Content.Length\)\) } catch { Write-Host "Error: $_" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Teeth886/Teeth886.github.io/pages"; Write-Host "Source branch: $\($r.source.branch\)"; Write-Host "Build type: $\($r.build_type\)"; Write-Host "URL: $\($r.html_url\)" } catch { Write-Host "Error: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Teeth886/Teeth886.github.io/pages" -Headers @{"Accept"="application/vnd.github+json"}; $r | ConvertTo-Json } catch { Write-Host "Status code: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode\)"; try { $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader\($_.Exception.Response.GetResponseStream\(\)\); Write-Host $reader.ReadToEnd\(\) } catch {} })
